description: Read-only Model Context Protocol server over Emiliano G.O.'s public portfolio: featured case studies, secondary packages, their stack and links, and his professional profile. No authentication, no writes.

tools.name: list_projects
tools.description: List every featured case study and secondary package, with category, summary, stack and links.

tools.name: get_project
tools.description: Return one project by id: category, summary, stack, links and its case-study URL.

tools.name: search_projects
tools.description: Search projects by free-text query across name, summary, stack and category.

tools.name: get_profile
tools.description: Return Emiliano G.O.'s name, role, location, spoken languages and profile links.

instructions: Call tools/list to inspect the schemas, then tools/call. All tools are read-only and unauthenticated; results are sourced from the same JSON that renders the website.
